# cycloid_plugin_widgets (Data Source)

Query organization-level plugin widgets by placement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `placement` (String) The widget placement type to filter by. Valid values: `component`, `sideMenuPage`.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) The organization canonical, defaults to the provider `default_organization`.

### Read-Only

- `widgets_json` (String) JSON-encoded array of widget objects.
